top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by induced proximity turns ubiquitin transfer into a reaction directed to a chosen protein by a small molecule. It is backed by ternary-complex co-crystal structures and independent reproduction, and the cereblon identification explains thalidomide-type drugs that are in routine clinical use. The Crews, Deshaies and Handa trio maps onto separable, attributable steps, and the citation rests on induced proximity and the cereblon mechanism, not on the clinical status of PROTACs. Ionizable lipid nanoparticles (P002) come second as mature but closer to formulation, and C-N coupling (P003) third as clean but a completion of the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
